text: Here is what happened in international relation in the last 24 hours. Iran, Hezbollah, the Houthis, multiple threats, multiple fronts, and one small country at the center of it all. So how does Israel keep defending itself? The answer lies in three major pillars, advanced technology, intelligence, and strategic alliances. Israel's iron dome intercepts many incoming rockets, while David's sling and arrow provide additional layers of missile defense. But its strategy goes beyond weapons. Advanced radar, intelligence networks, and rapid military coordination help detect threats and respond quickly. Israel has also built a powerful defense industry, developing sophisticated missiles, surveillance systems, and military technology. Another key factor is its strategic partnership with the United States, which provides military assistance and supports joint defense programs. In a region shaped by constant tension, Israel continues investing in innovation, military readiness, and national security. Its strategy, detect threats, strengthen defenses, and adapt before the battlefield changes.
